current.text: Queta and Mitchell Robinson compete for the starting center job in Boston.
The newest expert view is that Queta starts and closes many games. Robinson cannot play starter minutes. Queta's minutes could rise from 24 to 25 up to 26 to 27.
His 30-minute upside is probably gone now that Robinson is in Boston. About 24 to 25 minutes still gives him value but limits his upside.
He signed an extension worth about 14 to 15 million USD per year. It covers this season and four more.
One expert thinks he would accept a bench role.
The expert values him at pick 90 to 110, while his ESPN ADP is 136. Take him near 90 if you need a center, and let him slide toward 110 if you do not. Experts would draft him over Robinson.
Boston has a very deep roster with at least 12 rotation-level players.
Boston plays 4-3-4 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21. That is one game short of the maximum.

durable.text: He does not take threes and lacks shooting range.
He does not need threes to have fantasy value.
He has been working on a mid-range jumper and has a floater. He shoots a bit over 70% from the line.
His outside shooting is not something to rely on.
He has good chemistry with Payton Pritchard and makes good kick-out passes on the short roll.

note: Queta is a cheap center. He went for 1 USD in our league last season, and Yahoo values him at 4 USD and ESPN at 2 USD. His market ranks of 107 and 118 sit inside the expert range of 90 to 110. He projects about 65% FG on 6.3 attempts, 7.8 rebounds and 1.2 blocks with few turnovers, so he is a strong late buy for punt 3PM builds and any team short on a center. Early in the season, check whether he starts over Mitchell Robinson and plays 26 or more minutes, because that decides whether he is a starter for us or only a streamer.
